title: ScaleEvals: Scaling Generalist Policy Evaluation through Reset-Free Autonomous Play
abstract: arXiv:2611.28411v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Real-world evaluation of generalist robot policies is bottlenecked by manual resets, human grading, and small fixed task suites with limited diagnostic coverage. We present ScaleEvals, a scalable reset-free protocol that evaluates policies through continuous physical play across a robot fleet. A VLM AutoPrompter generates scene-grounded tasks with difficulty estimates, language prompts, and skill tags, enabling performance analysis across diverse rollouts. A VLM AutoGrader assesses task progress, achieving 90.7% agreement with human graders. Scores are aggregated via a soft-win Bradley-Terry model, while tag-stratified ANOVA provides interpretable capability diagnostics. Across 3,000+ physical autonomous rollouts on DROID and YAM, ScaleEvals achieves 23.0 net rollouts/hr per station while reducing active human labor by 98%. By ranking five SOTA generalist policies, ScaleEvals correlates with held-out manual evaluation ranking on DROID

translated_title: ScaleEvals：通过免重置自主游戏扩展通用策略评估
translated_abstract: 真实世界中通用机器人策略的评估受到手动重置、人工评分以及诊断覆盖范围有限的小型固定任务集的瓶颈制约。我们提出了ScaleEvals，这是一种可扩展的免重置评估协议，通过机器人群的持续物理游戏来评估策略。VLM自动提示器生成基于场景的任务，包括难度估计、语言提示和技能标签，从而实现对多样化轨迹的性能分析。VLM自动评分器评估任务进展，与人类评分者的一致性达到90.7%。分数通过软胜Bradley-Terry模型进行聚合，同时标签分层的方差分析提供可解释的能力诊断。在DROID和YAM上进行的3,000多次物理自主轨迹实验中，ScaleEvals每个工作站实现每小时23.0次净轨迹，同时将主动人工劳动减少98%。通过对五个最先进的通用策略进行排名，ScaleEvals与DROID上的留出人工评估排名具有相关性。
tldr: ScaleEvals提出了一种免重置的可扩展机器人策略评估协议，利用VLM自动生成任务与自动评分，结合Bradley-Terry模型聚合分数和标签分层方差分析进行能力诊断，在3,000多次真实自主实验中实现每小时23次净评估并将人工劳动减少98%，其排名结果与人工评估高度一致。
en_tdlr: ScaleEvals presents a scalable reset-free evaluation protocol that uses VLM-based auto-prompting and auto-grading to assess generalist robot policies through continuous autonomous play, achieving 23.0 net rollouts/hr per station while reducing human labor by 98% across 3,000+ real-world rollouts, with rankings that correlate with held-out manual evaluation.
